chunks: What the Shaykh—may Allah the Exalted support him—informed me of, from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from a number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad and Abū Dāwūd together, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān, from Samāʿah, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

If you forget and wash your arms before your face, then repeat washing your face, then wash your arms after the face. And if you begin with your left arm before the right, then repeat on the right, then wash the left. And if you forget wiping your head until you wash your feet, then wipe your head, then wash your feet.

key_terms.الْأَيْسَرِ: the left side, here referring to the left arm
key_terms.الْأَيْمَنِ: the right side, here referring to the right arm which has priority
key_terms.ذِرَاعَيْكَ: your two arms in the washing sequence of wudu (ablution)
key_terms.رَأْسِكَ: your head, which is to be wiped in wudu (ablution)
key_terms.رِجْلَيْكَ: your two feet, mentioned as the final step in the described sequence
key_terms.مَسْحَ: wiping, specifically the wiping of the head in wudu (ablution)
key_terms.وَجْهِكَ: your face, which must be washed before the arms in wudu (ablution)

ai.seo_question: What should be done if the order of wudu (ablution) is forgotten and performed incorrectly?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the required order in wudu (ablution) and what must be redone if the sequence is disturbed out of forgetfulness. It emphasizes that the face comes before the arms, the right arm before the left, and wiping the head before washing the feet.
